codex.name: Codex (OpenAI)
codex.notes: GPT-5.5 remains OpenAI's frontier (2026-06 Codex docs). GPT-5.4 retained as cheaper fallback. gpt-5.4-mini used for embarrassingly-parallel fan-out (per-file anti-slop). gpt-5.2-codex pinned for the security gate — OpenAI's strongest cybersecurity model. gpt-5.3-codex-spark (near-instant preview) is ChatGPT Pro-only; not routed.

claude.name: Claude (Anthropic)
claude.notes: Opus 4.8 is the current Opus frontier — same API surface as 4.7 (adaptive thinking only, no sampling params). claude-fable-5 (released 2026-06-09, $10/$50 per MTok — 2x Opus) is the optional escalation tier for the hardest long-horizon reviews; it can return stop_reason 'refusal' on cyber/bio-adjacent content, so any gate routed to it MUST fall back to claude-opus-4-8 on refusal. Sonnet 4.6 = workhorse. Haiku 4.5 = fan-out worker (200K ctx).

codex_plugin_cc.name: Codex Plugin for Claude Code (OpenAI official)
codex_plugin_cc.notes: OpenAI's official codex-plugin-cc — opt-in alternative to codex-mcp-server. Provides /codex:review and /codex:adversarial-review primitives. Set enabled=true and matching mcp_server entry to use.

anti_slop.note: Per-file scoring is embarrassingly parallel — fan out one worker per file.

devils_advocate.note: Frontier reasoning matters here — keep on the top-tier model.

gap_analysis.note: 10-dimension comparison doesn't need frontier — Sonnet/GPT-5.4 sufficient.

security.note: Routed to gpt-5.2-codex (OpenAI's strongest cyber model). Opt-in: set blocking=true to make `git commit` require a completed security gate. Run via the codex-security agent.

routing.note: tier maps to provider.{tier}_model: 'frontier'->model, 'fallback'->fallback_model, 'worker'->worker_model, 'security'->security_model, 'escalation'->escalation_model. Adding a new provider: add to providers{} and reference in routing/gates.

scoring.note: max_rounds reduced 3->2 in v3.0.0: GPT-5.5 mid-task self-correction means round 3 rarely changes verdicts.

concurrency.note: max_parallel_claude raised 2->3 to absorb Opus 4.7 tokenizer overhead (~1.35x). max_fanout_workers caps Haiku/gpt-5.4-mini parallelism for per-file gates.
